How to Apply
Please be sure to contact potential advisors prior to applying, in order to ensure that they are recruiting new students.
Academic Preparation
Applicants are expected to have a bachelor's degree or its equivalent in a biological or physical science or in mathematics. Undergraduate coursework should include one year each of physics, chemistry, calculus, additional biology or geology. Except under unusual circumstances a minimum undergraduate or postgraduate GPA of 3.0 is required for admission to any graduate program at UCSB. Applicants may apply for either the M.S. or Ph.D. degree program. A Masters degree is not required to enter the Ph.D. program.
All applicants must fulfill the general requirements for admission to graduate status at UCSB. Applicants should specify their general areas of interests within marine science on their application and provide a clear and focused statement of purpose.
Review Faculty Profiles and Research
Applicants to the Program must be accepted by a faculty advisor with whom they wish to work and who has agreed to supervise the student's graduate training and thesis dissertation research. Therefore, applicants are strongly encouraged to contact individual faculty members in IGPMS whose research interests coincide with their own early in the application process and to list potential advisors on their applications.
Admission decisions are based on intellectual potential and promise, competitiveness of the academic record, programmatic fit, and space availability.
Applying
Application Requirements
Letters of Recommendation
Three letters of recommendation are required for a completed application.
Transcript
Scanned official transcripts (watermark or seal) from institutions where you have completed 12 units or more must be uploaded to your application.
Statement of Purpose and Supplemental Documents *
Statement of Purpose
Personal History Statement (250 word minimum)
Resume/Curriculum Vitae (CV)
* There is no page length requirement for the Statement of Purpose and Resume/Curriculum Vitae (CV)
Exam Scores
IGPMS no longer considers the GRE for admissions.
Applicants whose native language is not English are required to take the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), the International English Language Testing System (IELTS), or the Duolingo English Test (DET).
The university minimum score requirements for accepted exams are listed below:
Minimum TOEFL internet-based test (iBT) and TOEFL iBT Home Edition: 80 (exams taken before 1/21/2026) or 4.0 (exams taken on or after 1/21/2026)
Minimum IELTS Academic and IELTS Indicator: Overall Band Score of 7
Minimum Duolingo English Test (DET): 120
Transfer Permission (optional)
If your application is not advanced by IGPMS but deemed a potential fit to the Biological Engineering Program, you may use the transfer permission form to consent for your application to be transferred for possible consideration by the Biological Engineering Program. Complete the Transfer Permission form and upload it with your application as a supplemental document.
Application Fee Waivers
Application fee waivers are available to qualified U.S. citizens and permanent residents who demonstrate evidence of financial need or proof of participation in an undergraduate research program such as McNair Scholars or the California Alliance for Minority Participation (CAMP). You may apply for a fee waiver within the online application. Within your application click on the Payment Information tab and scroll down to the fee waiver information. You must submit your fee waiver request at least two weeks before the application deadline. If you have questions about the fee waiver process, please contact the IGPMS Graduate Advisor.
